auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Metabase API key sent with the X-API-Key header. Create an API key from Admin settings > Authentication > API keys in Metabase.

extraFields.label: Instance URL
extraFields.description: Your public HTTPS Metabase instance URL. URLs ending in /api are also accepted.

actions.name: construct_native_query
actions.description: Construct SQL for saving as a question. This handle cannot be run by execute_query or query; use execute_sql to execute SQL.

inputSchema.description: Native SQL and its target database.

queryHandle.description: Stored query handle from construct_query or construct_native_query. Subject to server expiry and caller ownership.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Constructed query handle; construction does not execute the query.

actions.name: construct_query
actions.description: Construct portable MBQL 5 without executing it; returns a stored query handle.

query.description: Portable MBQL 5 query. Discover exact names with search_content/read_resource and read metabase://docs/construct-query.md; nested native query keys are passed unchanged.

prompt.description: Exact original user message, if available.

inputSchema.description: Structured query construction.

queryHandle.description: Stored query handle from construct_query or construct_native_query. Subject to server expiry and caller ownership.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Constructed query handle; construction does not execute the query.

actions.name: create_collection
actions.description: Create a collection, optionally nested under a parent.

inputSchema.description: Collection creation.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Created collection.

actions.name: create_dashboard
actions.description: Create a dashboard with optional saved questions, automatically positioned.

collectionId.description: Destination collection. On creation, omission uses the API-key caller's default (root on v0.63.16); on update it leaves the collection unchanged. MCP cannot move existing content to root with null.

inputSchema.description: Dashboard creation.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Created dashboard.

actions.name: create_metric
actions.description: Save constructed MBQL as a metric: one aggregation and at most one date/datetime grouping.

queryHandle.description: Stored query handle from construct_query or construct_native_query. Subject to server expiry and caller ownership.

collectionId.description: Destination collection. On creation, omission uses the API-key caller's default (root on v0.63.16); on update it leaves the collection unchanged. MCP cannot move existing content to root with null.

visualizationSettings.description: Native Metabase visualization settings. Keys are passed unchanged.

inputSchema.description: Save a constructed query. Native SQL handles may be saved as questions, not metrics.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Saved question or metric.

actions.name: create_question
actions.description: Save a constructed MBQL or SQL query as a question.

queryHandle.description: Stored query handle from construct_query or construct_native_query. Subject to server expiry and caller ownership.

collectionId.description: Destination collection. On creation, omission uses the API-key caller's default (root on v0.63.16); on update it leaves the collection unchanged. MCP cannot move existing content to root with null.

visualizationSettings.description: Native Metabase visualization settings. Keys are passed unchanged.

inputSchema.description: Save a constructed query. Native SQL handles may be saved as questions, not metrics.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Saved question or metric.

actions.name: execute_query
actions.description: Execute constructed MBQL and return rows and columns. Native SQL handles are not supported.

queryHandle.description: Stored query handle from construct_query or construct_native_query. Subject to server expiry and caller ownership.

inputSchema.description: Supply exactly one handle or base64-encoded MBQL query.

continuationToken.description: Pass to query for the next page, when available.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Successful query results. Tool and query failures raise provider errors.

actions.name: execute_question
actions.description: Run a saved question. Parameterized questions and input template tags are not supported by native MCP.

inputSchema.description: Saved question.

continuationToken.description: Pass to query for the next page, when available.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Successful query results. Tool and query failures raise provider errors.

actions.name: execute_sql
actions.description: Execute native SQL. Requires native-query permission and the instance's execute-SQL setting to be enabled.

inputSchema.description: Native SQL and its target database.

continuationToken.description: Pass to query for the next page, when available.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Successful query results. Tool and query failures raise provider errors.

raw.description: The raw Metabase API response object.

actions.name: list_collections

collections.description: Metabase collections returned by the API.

actions.description: List Metabase dashboards visible to the API key.

actions.name: list_databases
actions.description: List Metabase databases visible to the API key.

includeAnalytics.description: Whether to include analytics database metadata.

saved.description: Whether to return saved query databases.

includeEditableDataModel.description: Whether to include editable data model metadata.

excludeUneditableDetails.description: Whether to exclude details the API key cannot edit.

includeOnlyUploadable.description: Whether to return only uploadable databases.

routerDatabaseId.description: Router database ID to filter by.

canQuery.description: Whether to return databases the API key can query.

canWriteMetadata.description: Whether to return databases the API key can edit metadata for.

actions.name: list_mcp_resources
actions.description: Discover native MCP resources. Only documentation resources can be read by this connector; Apps are not supported.

inputSchema.description: No input required.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Native resources across all discovery pages.

actions.name: list_mcp_tools
actions.description: Discover native MCP tools and their upstream schemas. Unknown tools are discoverable, not automatically executable.

inputSchema.description: No input required.

name.description: Native tool name (search maps to search_content).

inputSchema.description: Upstream JSON input schema.

outputSchema.description: Upstream JSON output schema.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Available native tools across all discovery pages.

actions.name: query
actions.description: Execute MBQL or fetch its next page. Native MCP returns pages of 200 rows within a 2,000-row total budget.

query.description: Portable MBQL 5 query. Discover exact names with search_content/read_resource and read metabase://docs/construct-query.md; nested native query keys are passed unchanged.

queryHandle.description: Stored query handle from construct_query or construct_native_query. Subject to server expiry and caller ownership.

continuationToken.description: Token from a previous query page.

inputSchema.description: Supply exactly one query, queryHandle, or continuationToken.

continuationToken.description: Pass to query for the next page, when available.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Successful query results. Tool and query failures raise provider errors.

actions.name: read_mcp_resource
actions.description: Read native metabase://docs/ documentation, not entities or MCP Apps resources.

inputSchema.description: Documentation resource.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Documentation contents.

actions.name: read_resource
actions.description: Read up to five Metabase entity URIs. Preserves individual resource errors; list endpoints cap at 25 items.

inputSchema.description: Entity resource URIs.

content.description: Resource content; shape depends on URI.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Entity resources and their formatted representation.

items.description: Metabase model type to include in search results.

results.description: Metabase search results returned by the API.

raw.description: The raw Metabase API response object.

actions.name: search_content
actions.description: Search native Metabase MCP content using keyword or semantic queries (not the REST search action). Requires native MCP on the instance.

semanticQueries.description: Natural-language queries; availability depends on instance search configuration.

inputSchema.description: Native search queries.

raw.description: Complete native MCP response, including content blocks and metadata.

outputSchema.description: Native search results.
